Central carbon metabolism in S

Central carbon metabolism in S. epidermidis during glucose metabolism under planktonic and biofilm conditions. (A) Enzymes identified in planktonic and biofilm cells by proteomics are highlighted in blue; metabolic end-products are shown in boxes. Pathways link to PIA production and biofilm formation. (B–D) Regulatory elements affecting central metabolic pathways and biofilm formation are in grey ellipses, with green arrows indicating activation and red hooked arrows repression. Dashed arrows indicate indirect control. Green and red circles represent metabolites and energy-carrying molecules. Abbreviations of metabolites and enzymes: acetaldehyde (AcAld), acetate kinase (AckA), acetyl-coenzyme A (AcCoA), alcohol dehydrogenase (Adh), aconitase (Acn), acetolactate decarboxylase (AlsD), acetoin reductase (BudC), 3-hydroxybutyrate dehydrogenase (ButA), citrate (Cit), citrate synthase (CitZ), Embden-Meyerhof-Parnas (EMP), enolase (Eno), fructose-6-phosphate (F6P), fructose-1,6-bisphosphate (FBP), fructose-bisphosphate aldolase (FbaA), fumarate (Fum), glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GapA), glucose (Glc), glucosamine 1-phosphate (GlcN-1-phosphate), glucosamine 6-phosphate (GlcN-6-phosphate), S. epidermidis glucose permease (GlcPSe), glutamine–fructose-6-phosphate aminotransferase (GlmS), phosphoglycerate mutase (Gpm), intercellular adhesion proteins (IcaADBC), isocitrate dehydrogenase (Icd), isocitrate (Ist), lactate dehydrogenase (Ldh), malate (Mal), oxaloacetate (OAA), 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (Ogdh), pentose phosphate pathway (PPP), phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP), phosphoglycerate kinase (Pgk), phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (PckA), pyruvate dehydrogenase complex (Pdhc), pyruvate formate-lyase (Pfl), glucose-6-phosphate isomerase (Pgi), polysaccharide intercellular adhesion (PIA), phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate synthetase (Prs), glucose phosphoenolpyruvate phosphotransferase system (PtsG), phosphotransacetylase (Pta), pyruvate kinase (Pyk), pyruvate (Pyr), staphylococcal regulatory RNA E (RsaE), succinate dehydrogenase (Sdh), succinyl-coenzyme A (SCoA), succinate (Suc), dihydrolipoamide succinyltransferase (SucB), succinyl-CoA synthetase beta subunit (SucC), succinyl-CoA synthetase alpha subunit (SucD), transaldolase (Tal), triosephosphate isomerase (TpiA), UDP-N-acetylglucosamine (UDP-GlcNAc). Superscript letters refer to source studies: aMartínez-García et al. 2021; bGonçalves et al. 2022; cOliveira et al. 2023; dYao et al. 2005; eUribe-Alvarez et al. 2016; fPedroza-Davila et al. 2020; gCalvo et al. 2022; hVuong et al. 2005; iSadykov et al. 2008; jHandke et al. 2008; kLou et al. 2014); lZhu et al. 2017; mWu et al. 2015; nConlon et al. 2002; oJeng et al. 2008; pHoang et al. 2019; qLerch et al. 2019; rSchoenfelder et al. 2019; sSadykov et al. 2011; tVuong et al. 2003; uTormo et al. 2005
